description: Contact create, update, status change, delete and bulk delete through the HTTP routes record the acting user (actorType USER, actorId = req.user.id) on the ContactEvent and the ContactAuditEntry; the KEY adapter and automation callers keep SYSTEM. Landed as R0-CT-03 at 87ca2b90 (d479fe67 tests first, db4ee154 fix, e448b8bd review repairs ST-1 reassign scope, ST-2 delete-once, ST-3 bulk traces). Run from apps/server against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/contacts-audit-actor.integration.test.ts test/crm.e2e.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-03-vitest.json, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/contacts-audit-actor.json --report .proof/r0-03-vitest.json. RED-BEFORE: these two test files on the unmodified source at 9c1163c1 fail 22 of 51: contacts-audit-actor 15 of 24 (all 11 NEGATIVE CONTROL cases, the three ST-1 positive controls, which assert the USER actor, and the repeat bulk delete) and crm.e2e 7 of 27 (actor forwarding on create, update and delete, the update-scoping and duplicate-409 spy assertions, and the handler-level 401).
requiredCases: fixture sanity (real rows) seeded one tenant with an owner and a write-scoped staff member and no contacts

ST-1: PATCH cannot reassign a contact without the reassign permission the business owner may always reassign through PATCH
